summary: After the broker drops the socket, nothing of the last connection carries over: the first packet after the reconnect has a price but no feed time (ft), trade time (ltt) or change (pc), and the frame has none of them.

notes: Partial updates overlay within a connection only: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds; lead correction 2026-11-09, .lane/107/decisions.md: a field a partial packet omits is unchanged, not unknown. Both sides drop their cached snapshots on a new connection (the web's _resubscribe_all).

deviations.reason: The first packet of the new connection has no trade time (ltt); the web's Shoonya adapter, whose cache was cleared, sends last_trade_time null. No key is sent as JSON null: the desktop leaves it out.
The first packet of the new connection has no feed time (ft); the web sends shoonya_timestamp 0 for it. A field the stream does not carry is left out.

The first packet of the new connection has no change (pc); the web sends percent_change 0.0 for it (safe_float(data.get('pc'))). A field the stream does not carry is left out, and the desktop works no change out where the web only forwards Noren's.
Noren's touchline carries the book totals (tbq, tsq), and the web's Shoonya Quote dict drops them: lost data. The desktop keeps them (lead decision: data a web adapter drops from a mode is kept).
